package.description: Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

en-US.description: Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.
en-US.longDescription: Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
en-US.name: Lexora Buddy

zh-CN.description: 具备插件、内置浏览器、工作区文件与本地模型支持的桌面 AI Agent。
zh-CN.longDescription: Lexora 是在真实桌面实践中自我演化的个人 AI Agent。它不局限于代码助手的角色，也能陪你整理资料、打磨作品、安排日常。你说出目标，它持续推进，让文字成为工作、创作与生活的起点。
